findings.title: Negative-control helper swallows its own unexpected-acceptance failure
findings.actual: expect_reject yields, raises GuardError when the block returns, then rescues GuardError over both operations and returns true.
findings.expected: The negative control must fail when its block is accepted.
findings.impact: Title/edge/path/target/design negative probes wrapped here cannot distinguish actual rejection from erroneous acceptance. Their observed offline PASS is a vacuous oracle.
findings.correction: Rescue only the exception thrown by the yielded operation; raise unexpected-acceptance failure outside that rescue. Add a meta-control proving an intentionally accepting block fails. Preserve actual guards and controls, then re-freeze executor and every contract/nested review executor digest.
findings.underlying_guards: Nine independent strict negative probes rejected actual invalid inputs. This does not excuse the defective frozen harness.

binding_checks.executor_reviews: Separate actual CODE artifact_sha256 and TEST proposal_sha256 must equal current contract digest; both executor_sha256 fields must equal current script digest. Final paths/fields/nested values checked.
